recentItems.title: How To Be A Hero Like Lilo 🏄🦸 | Hero Camp | @disneykids
recentItems.description:
Lilo is a little girl with a gigantic heart, and an incredible imagination! When Lilo needs a friend, she meets Stitch, who turns her and her sister Nani's lives upside down. Even though Stitch causes a lot of chaos, Lilo uses her incredible hero skills to help him become part of their 'ohana, even when it means facing off with aliens! Learn how Lilo uses her loving heart, her imagination, and cleverness to be a true hero. 

Welcome to Hero Camp, where you'll learn to be a hero just like your favorite Disney and Pixar characters! We'll break down the incredible traits that make our heroes legendary and inspire us all.

recentItems.title: The Martian Chipmunks/Two and a Half Chipmunks/Koi Ride | Chip 'n' Dale: Park Life S2 E1
recentItems.description:
Chip’s refusal to ask for directions lands them on an entirely different planet! They start a happy new life but when Dale realizes they have been in the park the whole time, he must decide whether or not to reveal the truth. / An encounter with a young chipmunk seems to reveal a long lost close relative of Chip’s. The trio start a life as a family until they realize she isn’t a relative; she is the squirrel daughter of their biggest rival! Chip and Dale try to keep their family together even when the truth comes out. / Dale believes he’s accidentally turned Chip into a koi fish and tries to help his friend adapt to his new aquatic life. But when their friendship is threatened by all the changes, Dale thinks he has no choice but to transform himself in order to maintain their connection.
